proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ a b α β s t hli hne hEq
  have h0 : (1 - s - t * α) • a + (s * β - (1 - t)) • b = 0 := by linear_combination (norm := module) hEq
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := LinearIndependent.pair_iff.mp hli _ _ h0
  have hd : 1 - α * β ≠ 0 := fun h => hne (by linarith)
  have hs : s * (1 - α * β) = 1 - α := by linear_combination -h1 - α * h2
  have c1 : 1 - s = α * (1 - β) / (1 - α * β) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff hd]; linear_combination -hs
  have c2 : s * β = β * (1 - α) / (1 - α * β) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff hd]; linear_combination β * hs
  rw [c1, c2]
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (a b : V) (α β s t : ℝ), LinearIndependent ℝ ![a, b] → α * β ≠ 1 → (1 - s) • a + (s * β) • b = (1 - t) • b + (t * α) • a → (1 - s) • a + (s * β) • b = (α * (1 - β) / (1 - α * β)) • a + (β * (1 - α) / (1 - α * β)) • b
